reason: The model controls for collab_index_2023, a 2023 survey measure taken after the 2021-22 remote-work period. It is a post-treatment mediator or collider, so conditioning on it biases the remote_share estimate. The analysis also trims the top and bottom 1% of the outcome, so it does not use the full sample. It does control for the pre-period outcome, but that doesn't fix the other two problems. I couldn't re-run the analysis because shell access was denied, so this rests on reading the code.
